name: design-campaign-authority-and-sync
reason: Server-authoritative campaign state with source/replica instance model, share grants, and scope-filtered event broadcast (GM full view, players receive only in-scope events) on the existing hash-chained SQLite event journal; driven by the 2026-08-07 visual-audit finding that campaigns are browser-local. CAMP-01H / PR 1245 landed on main at 2a8a46183; implementation remains gated on the later parent 9.1 receipt. Reconciled 2026-08-20 (council decision 2026-08-20-campaign-journal-reconciliation-and-next-work): sole surviving home for campaign journal work; absorbed the superseded adopt-campaign-event-journal-authority (design D10 + rewritten D4 + Group 5); journal-bound implementation gates on the narrow dependencies named in its tasks preamble. Reviewed 2026-09-15 against exact main: 26 of 30 boxes are checked. Task 1.6 P-A now has its whole crash-window stack merged and main-verified - the jsdom half PR #1694 c40a394f6, the cold-reload proof spec PR #1709 a11ef14fd, the F1 reconciliation fix PR #1710 83887b746 and the case (a) tab-close discard repair PR #1711 1e43090c5 - and stays OPEN only on the navigation-discard residual under owner decision OD-flush-mechanism, since Chromium 143 aborts the keepalive fetch before dispatch when the document leaves by navigation, leaving the "hard reload" half of the box own wording uncovered. The Group 6 source-only contract projection opened by D12 has P0b landing as PRs #1686/#1687/#1688 and 6.2a market durability as PRs #1698/#1699/#1700 plus the source-row stack #1706/#1707/#1708. Task 6.3 now has all six rows on main, the missing room-code-hydration leak row arriving with PR #1719 2b3075d82 (mutation-proven 1:1 against the single envelopeOf narrowing), but stays OPEN because the producer-row 1:1 falsification pass in campaignCommandPipeline.test.ts has not been run. Reviewed again 2026-09-15 (batch 3): task 6.1 is now closed - PRs #1721 15ca7b25b6 and #1722 fbb3f2c81f land the borrowed-handle CAS campaign write, the durable sourceReplayFence in CampaignPersistenceService.ts, and the P0a baseline capture under the prepared transaction, all main-verified. Task 6.4's bridge (the two compare-and-swap counters) also lands as PRs #1724 231c7848aa and #1725 dc8b8f65d2 - main-verified mapping, refresh and fence-echo - but stays open because no 6.2b caller is wired yet (PR #1724's own non-claim), so the bridge exists with nothing calling it. Still open: 1.6, 6.2 (6.2a client half unimplemented; 6.2b blocked on the single-player identity/seat owner decision), 6.3 and 6.4 (bridge landed, 6.2b caller not wired).
